title: Sensex jumps 1,534 points as Asia crashes: Nifty ends at 22,997 in its best day in four months
short: Sensex jumps 1,534 points as Asia crashes; Nifty at 22,997
dek: Korea fell 7.6% and Japan 4.9% in an AI sell-off. India went the other way, led by private banks, IT and Reliance. But most smaller stocks fell.
card: Sensex +1,533.72 at 74,315.61, Nifty +374.65 at 22,997.35. Private banks and IT led; PSU banks, Nestle and small caps fell.
